digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow routing and cancellation
propositions: Job-level always() predicates on seven full-route jobs remain true during GitHub workflow cancellation, preventing stale matrix and reusable jobs from being canceled promptly.
Superseding patchset runs consume 1,510+ seconds of successor admission delay and 1,785+ runner-seconds after replacement creation because canceled predecessor jobs do not stop.
Replace always() predicates with !cancelled() checks while preserving classifier-failure and docs-only fallback behavior to enable immediate cancellation of stale full-route work.
Live organic same-change replacements (PS3→PS4→PS5 pairs) demonstrate stale jobs now stop within 60–110 seconds of replacement creation instead of completing naturally.
